body.statement: Algorithms 1--2 of Lee, Ghassami, and Shpitser recursively construct systematic-selection identifying kernels by ancestor restriction, district decomposition, reachable closure and fixing, supported laid-back contexts, and the displayed Algorithm-2 conditional-independence and reachability search; their successful return is an identifying functional for the causal query.

attestation.note: Primary-source handle supplied; the claim is scoped to the algorithms' displayed successful cases and soundness result.
